text:
Isabelle Tran: Quick heads up — offer for candidate Noah Kim (Sr ML Engineer). Hiring manager is asking for a provisional comp uplift and an earlier start date. Need routing + ETA for decision.
Priya Kapoor: What's the uplift request and reason? LM asked for details? :thinking_face:
Isabelle Tran: Manager says other firm matched our base and added $15k sign-on. They're asking us to match base to the next band (M5 -> M6 provisional) plus $10k sign-on. Candidate can start 2 weeks earlier if we firm up paperwork.
Liam O'Connor: FYI payroll cutoff is this Friday. If start moves earlier than next payroll run we might need manual pay setup. @Finance Review can confirm impact.
Finance Review: Manual setup possible but needs approval from comp committee and legal for sign-on tax treatment. Also need compensation fields in Workday: band=M6 provisional, signon=10000.
Isabelle Tran: Noted. Priya, can you route to comp committee and legal? I'll confirm candidate acceptance window (48h).
Priya Kapoor: Routing now — tagging comp-committee and legal. hr-ops-bot will track approvals.
hr-ops-bot: Request 3471112223 received. Required approvals: comp-committee, legal, finance. Deadline set to 48h.
Priya Kapoor: Quick checklist I added:
```
- Band change form (M5 -> M6 provisional)
- Sign-on approval ($10k)
- Start date exception request (earlier by 2 weeks)
- Workday update + manual payroll flag if needed
```
Noah Kim: Appreciate the transparency team. I do have another offer but prefer Redwood if we can close quickly. Happy to accept with final paperwork.
Liam O'Connor: If comp committee approves today and legal signs off we can lock payroll manual and set start for 2026-04-20. Otherwise fallback start 2026-05-04.
Priya Kapoor: Comp committee confirmed verbally; formal sign-off incoming. Legal asked for language on sign-on clawback — they'll draft.
Finance Review: Confirmed we can process manual setup for 2026-04-20 but need final invoice code and manager cost center. Also need EOR flag for sign-on tax guidance.
Isabelle Tran: I've pinged the manager for cost center and invoice code. Manager says cost_center=ENG-MLE and will provide the invoice code by EOD.
hr-ops-bot: Approval update: comp-committee=approved, legal=pending, finance=pending. Notifications sent to approvers.
Priya Kapoor: If legal approves before 5pm we'll proceed with manual payroll and update candidate. Otherwise we'll ask candidate if they can hold until 04/27.
Isabelle Tran: Thanks all — I'll keep Noah informed. Will post confirmation here as soon as legal signs. :pray:
Liam O'Connor: Also flagging to eng-ops to reserve onboarding laptop earlier if start moves up.
Priya Kapoor: Adding onboarding ops to thread. cc: @Noah Kim — we might confirm kit schedule after sign-off.
Isabelle Tran: End of thread for now — next update when legal signs or manager provides invoice code.
